disposition_reason: The final paper contains an original ordered reconstruction task: Fig.6b compares linear and bounded plateauing-exponential fits to the same2649 empirical place-field trajectories using unadjusted R2. In-sample model fit is a valid source endpoint; no new predictive holdout is required. Exact source fit vectors, original observation support, full-panel aggregation and a defensible fixed-complexity superiority rule remain unrecovered. Descriptive biological effects and mechanistic claims remain distinct.

source_paper.title: Synaptic plasticity rules driving representational shifting in the hippocampus

evidence.supports: Mechanistic account of trial-by-trial place-field shifting in familiar/new environments.
Reused Dong et al. recordings, CA1/CA3 COM input files, separate optogenetics, figure-to-code mapping.

evidence.locator: 15-lap and 30-lap eligibility; animal assignments; COM conversion/centering and trajectory fits
evidence.supports: Original trajectory input units, eligibility, preprocessing and empirical linear/exponential fitting route; exact Fig.6b source-output parity remains unqualified.

evidence.locator: Comparison CA1 vs best models; P(CS) dynamic models
evidence.supports: Separate mechanistic slope-distribution and displacement comparisons; these do not replace the original empirical trajectory-fit endpoint.

evidence.locator: Final published Fig.6b caption; Methods, Analysis of PF trajectories, Eq.2 and goodness-of-fit comparison paragraph
evidence.supports: All2649 PFs are compared by linear versus three-parameter bounded plateauing-exponential unadjusted R2; the stated goal is description of the observed PF, not out-of-sample prediction.

target.description: Original Fig.6b reconstruction of each empirical onset-centered PF center-of-mass trajectory as a function of lap, comparing linear with plateauing-exponential fits. This is same-observation description, not prediction of unseen animals.

dataset.description: Author-supplied CA1_COM_withPFs.mat and CA3_COM_withPFs.mat reuse Dong et al.2021 recordings; authenticate their exact versions and Fig.6b fit-input/output linkage. Separate optogenetic data cannot substitute.

cohort.description: Fig.6b reports all2649 PFs. Recover the complete PF-to-animal/region/environment mapping and original inclusion/support before computing a comparison; neither example trajectories nor significant-fit subsets suffice.

split.description: Original fits and unadjusted R2 evaluate the same observed PF trajectory. The paper explicitly targets within-trajectory description. Preserve that access; a newly held-lap or held-animal score would be a separate extension.

inputs.description: Original lap indices and observed onset-centered COM trajectories, with source support/animal/environment identities. All source-used fit observations remain available to both author and candidate methods.

preprocessing.description: Recover exact Fig.6b lap support, missing-value/interpolation handling and onset centering from the result-producing source. Methods distinguishes interpolation for PCA/diffusion and eligibility from regression; do not transfer the15-lap PCA truncation or30-lap diffusion subset automatically to this fit task.

metric.description: Original unadjusted coefficient of determination R2 for each PF fit, with higher values indicating better reconstruction of the same observations. Source compares a two-parameter line with Amp*(1-exp(-n/tau))+epsilon; do not replace this metric by significance or adjusted R2.

aggregation.description: Preserve all2649 paired source fit results and region/environment membership. Fig.6b shows a full paired fit comparison; recover the exact score vector and predeclare a scientifically justified aggregate/decision without selecting favorable PFs.

comparison.primary_metric: Original Fig.6b full2649-PF unadjusted reconstruction R2 comparison; scalar aggregation unresolved

published_baseline.description: The original paired linear/plateau-exponential R2 result exists, but its complete numerical vector and a valid scalar baseline are not recovered. Example-PF scores and the Wilcoxon statistic are not substitutes.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: No authentic full2649-PF author rerun is qualified. Methods uses nonlinear least squares/trust region; starts [14,2,0] for positive linear slope and [-15,2,0] otherwise; bounds absolute Amp200cm, tau100laps and absolute epsilon25cm. Recover exact outputs, stopping and observation support before replay.

minimum_effect.rationale: A meaningful reconstruction gain requires a predeclared source-comparable complexity and selection budget, original residual scale and uncertainty. Arbitrarily flexible interpolation can raise in-sample R2 without a defensible scientific improvement; no invented numeric margin is imposed.

uncertainty.method: Predeclare a paired comparison of the original PF fit vector accounting for fields nested within animal and model-selection/fitting variation; preserve the original reconstruction estimand.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Animals for biological inference; PFs and laps are nested observations, not2649 independent animals.
uncertainty.rationale: A stronger signed-rank significance alone is not better reconstruction. Exact PF/animal provenance and a valid uncertainty/decision rule remain unresolved.

paper_win_requires: Recover the exact original2649-PF input and paired linear/nonlinear fit-score vector; reproduce the bounded author plateau-exponential reference on the same observations.
Preserve original lap support, centering, missingness/interpolation, cohort and unadjusted R2; a new holdout or selected-PF subset cannot replace this reconstruction task.

Freeze a source-comparable model-capacity and search/selection policy before candidate feedback. Document the original three-parameter nonlinear fit and two-parameter linear comparator; unrestricted interpolation or added effective degrees of freedom cannot earn a paper win.

Predeclare complete-panel aggregation, meaningful effect and dependence-aware uncertainty; require improved reconstruction against the original author result, not merely a larger effect or smaller p value.

Retain broader empirical/model/optogenetic outputs as separately assessed historical obligations. A qualified Fig.6b reconstruction gain must be labelled with that scope and cannot establish a plasticity mechanism or every paper claim.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison was performed; source-paper reproduction and source-author reruns are separate claims.

episode.improvement_loop: After source recovery and fixed-complexity admission, iterate using the original allowed observed COM inputs and declared fit-feedback budget. Original same-data fitting is intentional; no new predictive split is introduced.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze candidate family, parameterization, capacity, fitting/search budget, preprocessing and full-panel decision before final scoring.
episode.final_evaluation: Replay the frozen candidate and original author route on the complete original2649-PF reconstruction support. Report full paired scores and predeclared aggregation; protect scoring provenance without pretending source-observed trajectories are unseen data.
episode.baseline_policy: Published full-vector fits, fresh author reruns and local reconstruction controls are distinct. Source mean/median thresholds are not invented; budgets and exact replay must be qualified before activation.

blocking_issues: Exact original2649-PF fit score vector, empirical asset versions and PF/animal/condition mappings unresolved.
Original regression lap support, missingness/interpolation, parameter initialization/bounds/stopping and native author parity require authentication.
No fixed source-comparable complexity/search policy or full-panel aggregation is admitted; unconstrained in-sample flexibility is not scientific improvement.
Meaningful effect, valid paired uncertainty, working source-author/candidate evaluation and concrete episode budgets remain unresolved.
Canonical task binding must identify the original Fig.6b reconstruction endpoint while preserving broader descriptive/mechanistic history.

legacy.notes: Preserve all processed-trajectory OLS/error/coverage graders and mechanism summaries as calibration. The original paper also contains a valid ordered in-sample fit comparison; these local reconstruction controls do not yet reproduce its complete2649-PF score vector or establish superiority.
